message: As I’ve been juggling our family schedule, I’ve found a little joy in rediscovering low-tech fun. Planning for emergencies can feel overwhelming, but it doesn’t have to be! I recently came across a resource that offers practical tips for creating a family emergency plan—turning a serious task into a chance for connection and creativity. It’s a great reminder that being prepared can also mean finding fun ways to come together. What’s your favorite way to get your family involved in preparedness? 🤔
